import hashlib
import json
import platform
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import wave
from pathlib import Path

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source = base / "owned-synthetic-100ms.wav"
with wave.open(str(source), "wb") as stream:
    stream.setparams((1, 2, 16000, 0, "NONE", "not compressed"))
    stream.writeframes(struct.pack("<h", 0) * 1600)
cases = []
for fix in (False, True):
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(prefix="jev-protocol-owned-", suffix=".wav", delete=False, dir=base) as tmp:
        target = Path(tmp.name)
    try:
        command = ["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-i", str(source), "-t", "30", "-ac", "1", "-ar", "16000", str(target)]
        if fix:
            command.insert(1, "-y")
        started = time.monotonic()
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        output = {
            "variant": "owned-output-overwrite-adapter" if fix else "literal-pinned-reference-command",
            "command": command,
            "output_preexisted": True,
            "output_before_bytes": 0,
            "exit_code": result.returncode,
            "stdout": result.stdout[:1000],
            "stderr": result.stderr[:1000],
            "output_bytes": target.stat().st_size,
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 4),
            "output_sha256": hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        }
        if target.stat().st_size:
            with wave.open(str(target), "rb") as stream:
                output["wave_metadata"] = {"channels": stream.getnchannels(), "sample_rate": stream.getframerate(), "frames": stream.getnframes(), "sample_width": stream.getsampwidth()}
        cases.append(output)
    finally:
        target.unlink()
report = {
    "platform": platform.platform(),
    "ffmpeg_version": subprocess.check_output(["ffmpeg", "-version"], text=True).splitlines()[0],
    "driver_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "synthetic_source_bytes": source.stat().st_size,
    "synthetic_source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "source_seconds": 0.1,
    "source_rate": 16000,
    "source_channels": 1,
    "stdin": "DEVNULL for noninteractive job",
    "cases": cases,
    "gpu_used": False,
    "model_loaded": False,
}
assert cases[0]["output_bytes"] == 0 and "Not overwriting" in cases[0]["stderr"]
assert cases[1]["exit_code"] == 0 and cases[1]["wave_metadata"]["frames"] == 1600
report["probe_exit_code"] = 0
(base / "audio-overwrite-probe.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

"""Only allowlisted public protocol metadata leaves may leave the parser."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys
import urllib.request
from collections import Counter
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
revision = "5addda86ddee081a68fb067477ea100c221b8917"
tree = json.loads((base / "teacher-tree.json").read_text())
source_file = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) == 2 else "verification.json"
assert source_file in {"verification.json", "decision_config.json", "sha256.json"}
expected = next(item["size"] for item in tree if item["path"] == source_file)
assert expected == {"verification.json": 1318, "decision_config.json": 1174, "sha256.json": 1757}[source_file] and len(tree) == 22
url = f"https://huggingface.co/akhilaaa3/Jev-Omni/resolve/{revision}/{source_file}"
with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as response:
    raw = response.read(expected + 1)
assert len(raw) == expected
document = json.loads(raw)

tasks = json.loads((base.parents[1] / "configs/video-eval-assets.json").read_text())["mvbench"]["tasks"]
task_names = {task["task"] for task in tasks}
task_aliases = {Path(task["file"]).name: task["task"] for task in tasks}
task_aliases.update({Path(task["file"]).stem: task["task"] for task in tasks})
task_aliases.update({name: name for name in task_names})
protocol_fields = {
    "benchmark", "benchmark_name", "dataset", "dataset_name", "dataset_revision",
    "dataset_version", "split", "version", "revision", "task", "task_name", "tasks",
    "task_names", "num_frames", "video_frames", "frames", "fps", "seed", "frame_count", "sampled_frames", "start", "end", "audio_seconds", "sample_rate", "channels",
    "mvbench_row_ids", "public_mvbench_ids", "row_ids", "sample_ids", "eval_ids",
    "excluded_ids", "ids", "dataset_id", "dataset_split", "evaluated_tasks",
    "frame_count", "sampled_frames", "sampling_strategy", "clip_bounds",
    "start", "end", "audio_seconds", "sample_rate", "channels",
}
aggregate_fields = {
    "num_samples", "n_samples", "sample_count", "total_samples", "num_questions",
    "total_questions", "num_tasks", "task_count", "evaluated_samples", "total",
    "accuracy", "micro_accuracy", "macro_accuracy", "task_average", "correct",
    "n", "n_questions", "n_tasks", "num_examples", "n_eval", "eval_size",
    "samples", "questions", "total_count", "evaluated_count",
}
protected_prediction = {
    "prediction", "predictions", "prediction_index", "probabilities", "probability",
    "probs", "prob", "pred", "distribution", "logits", "scores", "confidence", "answer", "answers", "label", "labels",
    "target", "targets", "ground_truth", "expected", "expected_output", "output", "outputs",
}
protected_input = {"question", "questions", "prompt", "prompts", "state", "text", "input", "inputs", "messages", "options", "content"}
safe_datasets = {"MVBench", "mvbench", "OpenGVLab/MVBench", "MMAU", "mmau", "gamma-lab-umd/MMAU-test-mini"}
category_counts = Counter()
value_type_counts = Counter()
safe_metadata = []
unknown_task_fields = 0
protected_subtrees = 0
safe_protocol_key_hits = Counter()


def classify(key):
    normalized = key.lower()
    if normalized in protocol_fields:
        return "protocol"
    if normalized in aggregate_fields:
        return "aggregate"
    if normalized in protected_prediction or any(word in normalized for word in ("prediction", "prob", "logit")):
        return "protected_prediction_or_target"
    if normalized in protected_input:
        return "protected_input_content"
    if key in task_names or key in task_aliases:
        return "known_public_task_key"
    if normalized in {"mvbench", "mmau"}:
        return "known_public_benchmark_key"
    if normalized in {"noul", "choice", "score", "checks", "cases", "comparisons", "original", "merged", "before", "after", "image", "audio", "video"}:
        return "verification_case_or_modality_schema"
    if any(token in normalized for token in ("benchmark", "dataset", "protocol", "metadata", "summary", "evaluation", "notes", "description")):
        return "unexported_potential_protocol_schema"
    return "other_schema_key"


def visit(value, path="$", protected=False):
    global unknown_task_fields, protected_subtrees
    value_type_counts[type(value).__name__] += 1
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, child in value.items():
            category = classify(key)
            category_counts[category] += 1
            normalized = key.lower()
            blocked = protected or category.startswith("protected_")
            if not protected and category.startswith("protected_"):
                protected_subtrees += 1
            safe_path_key = normalized if category in {"protocol", "aggregate", "known_public_benchmark_key"} else "<object>"
            location = path + "." + safe_path_key
            if not blocked and category in {"protocol", "aggregate"}:
                safe_protocol_key_hits[normalized] += 1
                allowed = False
                exported = child
                if category == "aggregate" or normalized in {"num_frames", "video_frames", "frames", "fps", "seed", "frame_count", "sampled_frames", "start", "end", "audio_seconds", "sample_rate", "channels"}:
                    allowed = isinstance(child, (int, float)) and not isinstance(child, bool)
                elif normalized in {"benchmark", "benchmark_name", "dataset", "dataset_name"}:
                    allowed = isinstance(child, str) and child in safe_datasets
                elif normalized == "split":
                    allowed = child in ("train", "validation", "val", "test", "dev", "test-mini")
                elif normalized in {"revision", "dataset_revision"}:
                    allowed = isinstance(child, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", child) is not None
                elif normalized in {"version", "dataset_version"}:
                    allowed = isinstance(child, str) and re.fullmatch(r"v?\d+(?:\.\d+){0,3}", child) is not None
                elif normalized in {"task", "task_name"}:
                    allowed = isinstance(child, str) and child in task_aliases
                    if allowed:
                        exported = task_aliases[child]
                    elif isinstance(child, str):
                        unknown_task_fields += 1
                elif normalized in {"tasks", "task_names"} and isinstance(child, list):
                    allowed = all(isinstance(item, str) and item in task_aliases for item in child)
                    if allowed:
                        exported = [task_aliases[item] for item in child]
                    else:
                        unknown_task_fields += 1
                # IDs are never exported without an explicit public-MVBench
                # identity/schema validation step; this bounded pass reports hits only.
                if allowed:
                    safe_metadata.append({"path": location, "field": normalized, "value": exported})
            visit(child, location, blocked)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for child in value:
            visit(child, path + "[]", protected)


# Verify independent protocol extraction and payload exclusion on an owned
# synthetic document before parsing the official file. Never emit this fixture.
visit({"benchmark": "MVBench", "num_samples": 2786, "num_tasks": 14,
       "task_names": ["Action Count"],
       "predictions": {"num_samples": 123, "tasks": ["Action Count"],
                       "question": "DO_NOT_EXPORT_SYNTHETIC_SENTINEL"}})
assert {item["field"] for item in safe_metadata} == {"benchmark", "num_samples", "num_tasks", "task_names"}
assert all(item["value"] != 123 for item in safe_metadata)
assert "DO_NOT_EXPORT_SYNTHETIC_SENTINEL" not in json.dumps(safe_metadata)
category_counts.clear()
value_type_counts.clear()
safe_metadata.clear()
safe_protocol_key_hits.clear()
unknown_task_fields = protected_subtrees = 0
visit(document)
result = {
    "observed_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "source_url": url,
    "source_file": source_file,
    "source_revision": revision,
    "bytes": len(raw),
    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
    "tree_entry_count": len(tree),
    "tree_sha256": hashlib.sha256((base / "teacher-tree.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "network_bytes_this_source_fetch": len(raw),
    "key_category_counts": dict(category_counts),
    "value_type_counts": dict(value_type_counts),
    "protected_subtree_count": protected_subtrees,
    "safe_protocol_key_hits": dict(safe_protocol_key_hits),
    "independently_allowed_protocol_or_aggregate_metadata": safe_metadata,
    "unknown_task_metadata_fields_redacted_count": unknown_task_fields,
    "raw_input_prediction_target_values_exported": False,
    "raw_source_written_to_disk": False,
    "filter_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "training_data_or_private_project_files_read": False,
    "thresholds_changed": False,
    "owned_synthetic_redaction_and_metadata_test_passed": True,
    "exit_code": 0,
}
del document, raw
(base / (source_file + ".filtered.json")).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
